articles.summary: Healthcare applications require careful decisions about user authentication and access control. Whether you're building an EHR, a clinical workflow tool, or a patient portal, getting identity management right from the start will save you from costly architectural mistakes down the road.
articles.title: Identity Management - A Practical Guide

articles.summary: January was a packed month for Medplum. We shipped three patch releases (v5.0.11, v5.0.12, v5.0.13), published the 2026 Roadmap, and landed over 100 commits from 20+ contributors. The biggest themes this month were scheduling, the Provider app, and site reliability — all directly advancing our 2026 roadmap priorities.
articles.title: Medplum Monthly Update - January 2026
